Chapter 691 - 691 Entering; Spiritual Pearl!

Chapter 691 - 691 Entering; Spiritual Pearl!

691 Entering; Spiritual Pearl!

Everyone in the square was enveloped in light.

Then, they rushed toward the light screen.

The moment they entered the light screen, everyone disappeared like water drops into the sea. It was very mysterious.

“Senior Lin, let’s go in too,” Ma Zheng hurriedly said.

“Alright.” Lin Fan nodded.

The two of them took a step forward and walked straight into the light screen.

Lin Fan felt the space around him twist and distort, creating a strong suction force that pulled him and everyone else into different directions.

Lin Fan circulated his space power to keep Ma Zheng close to him.

After an unknown amount of time, Lin Fan and Ma Zheng finally landed on the ground.

At this moment, a crisp notification rang out in Lin Fan’s mind.

[Ding! Mission Completed: Enter the Heavenly Wind World. Reward: True Dragon Sword x1, Cosmos Sword Technique x1, Heaven and Earth Enlightenment x1.]

Instantly, an extremely profound and powerful sword technique appeared in Lin Fan’s mind, as well as a golden longsword that looked like a coiling dragon.

He had a feeling that as long as he used this sword, coupled with the Cosmos Sword Technique, it would be nothing difficult for him to destroy the world. It was extremely powerful.

After a while, Lin Fan finally suppressed the joy in his heart.

He looked into the distance.

In front of him was a dark forest with jagged rocks. The area was surrounded by a thin layer of mist.

“Senior Lin, I can only see the environment within 300 meters,” Ma Zheng said in shock.

One had to know…

Ma Zheng was a Star Traveller-level warrior. It was nothing for him to see everything at a glance.

However, the layer of white mist was like a thick wall, completely blocking his line of sight.

Lin Fan looked into the distance. His vision was also blocked by the white mist.

However, he had the Eyes of True Sight, so the obstruction was obviously reduced by a lot.

He could see everything within ten kilometers.

Lin Fan said, “My vision is also obstructed.”

He did not say how far he could see.

After all, the two of them had not reached the point of being honest about anything.

Lin Fan asked, “What should we do now? Turn around?”

Even though he had been at Revelation Planet for a period of time, because he was busy absorbing the Flame Crystal, he did not have the time to search for information about the Heavenly Wind World.

This was also one of the reasons why he let Ma Zheng follow by his side.

Ma Zheng thought for a moment and said, “We should be at the outer area of the Heavenly Wind World. We only need to search for ten spiritual pearls in ten years to enter the core area from the east. It’s said that there are many opportunities in the core area.”

At this point, Ma Zheng’s tone became heated.

“Of course, there are many unimaginable treasures even in the periphery.”

Lin Fan nodded.

Ma Zheng seemed to have thought of something and said, “I wonder where Qin Dachuan is. I hope I don’t run into him.”

As he spoke, he could not help but look around as if he was worried that Qin Dachuan would suddenly appear and attack him.

When Lin Fan heard Qin Dachuan’s name, a hint of displeasure surfaced in his heart.

He clearly remembered that Qin Dachuan had two stars of Hatred Points toward him.

In addition, before entering the Heavenly Wind World, the other party had threatened him.

Lin Fan understood that if he met Qin Dachuan in the Heavenly Wind World, he would definitely be at a disadvantage.

Since that was the case, he would strike first.

Hence, Lin Fan took out two spirit crystals and focused his attention on Curse.

[Do you wish to curse Qin Dachuan?]

“Yes!”

The two spirit stones instantly shattered and turned into powder.

At this moment, a sound came from the forest not far away.

Then, a giant spider suddenly jumped out.

It waved its steel-like claws, and the trees beside it were broken like grass.

A powerful aura swept over with a strong wind, causing Lin Fan’s and Ma Zheng’s clothes to flutter.

Ma Zheng said in a panic, “It’s a Planet-level beast! Moreover, it’s very likely to be equivalent to a mid-level Planet warrior!”

The Star Traveller-level was divided into nine levels.

The first, second, and third levels were the primary levels.

The fourth, fifth, and sixth levels were the intermediate levels.

The seventh, eighth, and ninth levels reached the high-level Planet realm.

Ma Zheng was only at the second level. He was no match for the giant spider.

Lin Fan looked at the giant spider and raised his hand. The shining True Dragon Sword appeared in his hand, and a dragon roar sounded out.

Lin Fan pulled out the True Dragon Sword and swung it at the giant spider.

“Sword of Heaven and Earth!”

The mighty sword energy was like a swift and violent thunder as it rushed out and pierced through the giant spider’s body, forming a long gully on the ground.

The giant spider broke into two halves and fell to the ground, losing all its vitality.

Blood splattered everywhere.

The air was filled with the thick smell of blood.

Ma Zheng stuttered, “S-Senior Lin, you’re so powerful!”

Back in the mystic realm, Ma Zheng already knew that Lin Fan was extremely strong.

However, he did not expect that Lin Fan could kill a mid-level Planet beast as easily as cutting tofu.

It was unimaginable.

Lin Fan did not care about Ma Zheng’s words.

He had placed his attention on the system.

[Ding! You’ve killed a level-four Planet exotic beast. You’ve obtained 40,000 experience points.]

Energy surged in his body.

His strength increased!

[Cultivation: Star Traveller Level 4 (60,000/200,000)]

Killing the exotic beasts here could actually increase his experience and cultivation!

This was simply like fighting monsters to level up!

This was the best way to improve!

Lin Fan was extremely happy.

After a while, he suppressed the joy in his heart.

When he looked down at the spider on the ground, he saw a silver-white pearl the size of a fist on the spider’s abdomen.

Lin Fan raised his hand, and the pearl flew in front of him.

“What is this?”

He felt a very strange energy from the bead.

“Spiritual pearl!” Ma Zheng said excitedly.

“Oh? This is a spiritual pearl? It’s in the body of a mutated beast?” Lin Fan was surprised.

“Spiritual pearls are scattered all over the periphery,” Ma Zheng said. “Some would be accidentally swallowed by mutated beasts.”

Lin Fan nodded. “Since that’s the case, let’s continue killing beasts.”

After all, killing exotic beasts could not only gain experience points, but they also had a chance of obtaining spiritual pearls. Why not?

He did as he said.

Lin Fan walked forward quickly.

After a while, he saw another exotic beast.

It was a python that was coiled around a thick tree trunk, almost blending into the tree.

As long as anyone passed by, it would suddenly swoop down and swallow that figure into its stomach.

Lin Fan swung his sword from afar. Without waiting for the python to react, he cut it and the tree into two.

A rumbling sound rang out.

[Ding! You’ve killed a level-four Planet exotic beast. You’ve obtained 40,000 experience.]

Unfortunately, there were no Spiritual Pearls in the body of this mutated beast.

However, it was not bad to gain experience.
